memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Asthma
  - Status: Patient reports daytime wheezing twice weekly, nighttime cough twice monthly, uses salbutamol SOS 2-3 puffs/day. No exacerbations in past month.
  - Plan: Continue salbutamol MDI 2 puffs SOS, budesonide-formoterol 200/6 µg inhaler two puffs BD, montelukast 10 mg HS. Measure weight and waist. Advise diet: breakfast - whole grain toast with egg white; lunch - mixed vegetable sambar with brown rice; dinner - grilled fish with steamed vegetables; snacks - fruit and nuts. Weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (above male cut‑off 90 cm). Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-07-10 at 10:30 am with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Asthma
  - Status: Daytime wheezing reduced to once weekly, night cough absent. Salbutamol SOS use down to 1‑2 puffs/day. Patient reports improved exercise tolerance.
  - Plan: Continue current inhalers. Reinforce spacer use. Review inhaler technique. Weight 77 kg, waist 90 cm (at cut‑off). Diet advice: breakfast - oats with milk and nuts; lunch - quinoa pulao with dal; dinner - chicken curry with millet roti; snacks - yogurt.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Spirometry with reversibility: FEV1 2.30 L (78% predicted), FVC 2.90 L (82% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.79. Post‑bronchodilator FEV1 2.55 L (88% predicted), increase 10.9% (>12%? actually 10.9% <12) – borderline reversibility. No significant obstruction.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Asthma Control Test (ACT) score: 22 (out of 25). Indicates well‑controlled asthma.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Asthma
  - Status: No daytime symptoms, no night cough, salbutamol use 0‑1 puff/week. Patient reports good control.
  - Plan: Consider stepping down budesonide-formoterol to 1 puff BD if control persists for next 3 months. Continue montelukast HS and salbutamol SOS. Weight 76 kg, waist 88 cm (below cut‑off). Diet advice: breakfast - idli with sambar; lunch - brown rice with vegetable curry; dinner - paneer tikka with salad; snacks - fruit.

- Asthma
  - Status: Mild intermittent wheezing during colds, otherwise asymptomatic. Salbutamol use 1‑2 puffs/week.
  - Plan: Maintain current regimen. Ensure flu vaccination. Weight 79 kg, waist 91 cm (slightly above cut‑off). Reinforce portion control. Diet advice: breakfast - multigrain toast with avocado; lunch - millet bisi bele bath; dinner - grilled chicken with steamed broccoli; snacks - roasted chana.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Asthma
  - Status: Well controlled, no exacerbations since last visit. Salbutamol SOS rare.
  - Plan: Continue current meds. Review inhaler technique. Weight 80 kg, waist 92 cm (above cut‑off). Emphasize aerobic activity. Diet advice: breakfast - poha with peanuts; lunch - quinoa salad with chickpeas; dinner - fish curry with brown rice; snacks - sprouts.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Eosinophil count: 0.32 ×10⁹/L (reference 0.05‑0.5). Total IgE: 85 IU/mL (reference <100). Both within normal limits.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Asthma
  - Status: Acute exacerbation after exposure to dust at work. Daytime wheezing, night cough, salbutamol use 8‑10 puffs/day. Peak flow dropped to 65% personal best.
  - Plan: Short course oral prednisolone 40 mg daily for 5 days, then taper. Increase budesonide-formoterol to 2 puffs BD for 2 weeks. Continue montelukast HS. Review in 1 week. Weight 81 kg, waist 93 cm. Diet advice: soft, easy‑to‑digest meals: breakfast - khichdi; lunch - dal rice with cooked veg; dinner - curd rice; snacks - banana.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Asthma
  - Status: Post‑exacerbation recovery. No wheeze, night cough absent, salbutamol use 1‑2 puffs/week. Peak flow back to 95% personal best.
  - Plan: Step down budesonide-formoterol to 1 puff BD. Continue montelukast HS and salbutamol SOS. Weight 80 kg, waist 91 cm (slightly above cut‑off). Encourage regular walking. Diet advice: breakfast - upma with vegetables; lunch - brown rice with sambar; dinner - grilled paneer with salad; snacks - nuts.
